_about: Quest state that probably lives in the WORLD save (.sav, SPUD), not the character JSON. The editor does not change any of this. Each entry is a stub for future world-save work: what, which steps, evidence, and status. Shown as warnings in the Main Quest tab.

world_saves.World B.sav: 251 KB; per prior string scan, almost no Dowdun Reach state and no WorldProgressManager boss records -> likely the safest world to replay in.
world_saves.World A.sav: 7.9 MB; WorldProgressManager records Velgar and Imaru defeated, world hooks/tags, CachedCharacterStates (a guest 'GuestChar').

stubs.what: Bastion barrier / gate actor state (open vs closed). The character flag GateOpen is set alongside it; the world may keep the barrier down after a character-only revert.
stubs.evidence: World survey (read-only decode of both worlds, 2026-11-24): the Bastion barrier actor only stores bCanBeDamaged; no open/closed state. The character flags drive it.

stubs.what: Dreaming Stone actor repaired/broken visual + interaction state (Avisk dialogue).
stubs.evidence: World survey: Dreamstone actor only stores bCanBeDamaged.

stubs.what: The 13 Shards of the Dreaming Stone world pickups (collected/hidden). Collected pickups stay collected in the world, so the shard hunt cannot be replayed with a character edit; editor never resets Fragment_N.
stubs.evidence: World survey: 9 shard fragment actors found, each only bCanBeDamaged; no collected flag. Fragment_N on the character is what counts.

stubs.what: Black Knight Titan (Gatekeeper) spawner / defeated state. Setting step 8+ on the character does not kill the Titan in the world; reverting from 8+ does not respawn it.
stubs.evidence: World survey: nothing named Titan/Gatekeeper/Black Knight in either world; the Titan has not been defeated yet, so a record may only appear after the kill.

stubs.what: CanEnterBastion (character bool, set on first barrier use) may have a world-side counterpart for the barrier interaction.
stubs.evidence: World survey: no world counterpart found.

stubs.what: Cathan / Wise Old Man / Doric NPC placement and dialogue state in Dowdun Reach; reverting to the entry steps may leave NPCs where the later steps put them.
stubs.evidence: World survey: Wise Old Man / Doric / Cathan variants only store bCanBeDamaged.

stubs.what: Completion requires Broken Titan's Wrath and grants rewards; setting step 9 on the character grants nothing.
Velgar defeated record in WorldProgressManager (confirmed present in World A.sav).
stubs.evidence: World survey: WorldProgressManager list entry (undecoded property type) in World A.sav. No tool edits it; Velgar can be re-fought in game via the Challenge Horn.

stubs.what: Wise Old Man temple visibility (WOMTempleHidden) and vault goblin visibility (VaultGoblinVisible) may have world actor counterparts.
stubs.evidence: World survey: these bool names only appear inside CachedCharacterStates (guest character copy).

stubs.what: Imaru defeated record in WorldProgressManager (confirmed present in World A.sav).
stubs.evidence: World survey: WorldProgressManager entry plus linked tags and a spawn-trigger switch. Imaru can be re-fought by re-collecting the curse fragments.
World survey: a single switch byte.

_other_world_state.name: Other world state found by the survey

stubs.what: World hooks, dragon event timers (WorldEventManager), boss altar bSummoned flag, Dowdun Reach lever and chest states, and god statues. Byte flips are possible (world-save parser) but their in-game effect is unknown.

_survey: Verified 2026-11-24 by read-only decode of both world saves. Recommendation: read-only display only; BKF needs no world edits.
